persona: Simulated overwhelmed beginner or mid-A1 learner
method: Agent inspection of the built local app with fresh validated synthetic progress in owned disposable Chromium contexts. This is simulated learner evidence, not observation of a human learner or a retention study.
scope: First lesson and due-review correction affordances

findings.title: An empty A1 weekly report recommends an A2 chapter check
reproduction: Create fresh course1 progress with no completed lessons, grammar attempts, diagnostics or active programme.
Inspect Useful next steps and the next-seven-day plan, then open the suggested step.
findings.observed: The report correctly said there was no dated evidence but recommended Choose an A2 chapter check, repeated that suggestion in the next-week plan, and opened #diagnostics with the heading What would help your A2 practice?. The Italian flow matched.
findings.learningRisk: The recommended difficulty is unsupported by the saved beginner plan. A novice could interpret the recommendation as the required next task. This is a simulated-persona inference, not a measured real-user outcome.
findings.fix: When no due review or specific diagnostic catch-up exists, offer Continue today and follow the saved plan. Keep the existing A2-topic link optional; infer no readiness from missing records.
findings.status: fixed; verified in owned isolated browser against the rebuilt local app

findings.title: Phone session entry stops above a long stage chooser, before the active task
reproduction: Open fresh Today at390×844 in EN or IT.
Observe the initial viewport before tapping a stage or scrolling.
findings.observed: Scroll remained at0. Six stage buttons occupied y657–1064; the warm-up activity began at1082, its input at1310 and Save at1503. At320px the save button was at1583. Tapping the already selected first stage scrolled correctly, but that extra action was not signposted.
findings.learningRisk: Continue initially looks like another contents screen, placing the first usable task below the phone viewport. The original Today primary action itself was visible at y592 EN390 and y626 IT390, so the finding concerns the destination rather than the Today card.
findings.fix: On initial entry at phone widths, focus and scroll the existing active-activity heading with the shared cancellable helper. Preserve the existing stage choice, drafts and desktop overview.
findings.status: fixed; verified in owned isolated browser against the rebuilt local app

strengthsObserved: Today presents one visible primary Continue action at both sampled phone widths.
The supported A1 programme is the default recommendation and alternatives are behind a disclosure.
Warm-up instructions include a first-day greeting/name alternative and a small expandable starter.
Existing activity-heading focus makes the already-selected stage button a working navigation shortcut.
preservation: The fixes change recommendation copy/destination and mobile mount focus only. They select no programme, change no day, write no progress, alter no grading and keep all content IDs.

additionalCoverage: Empty A1/A2 plans return to Today without mutation
Diagnostic practice links use ?practice=1 and preserve completed-unit production/position

verification.method: Simulated agent learner inspection, not real-user observation. Owned disposable Chromium and validated synthetic records; no shared profile/CDP or real learner state.
